nom: The Ordinary AHA 30% + BHA 2% High-Strength Peeling Solution for Brightening

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report closed comedones, blackheads and breakouts around the chin, with several saying weekly use cleared congestion and made pores appear smaller, though one warns oil-prone areas can sting more.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers describe the product as effective but drying if not followed immediately with a rich moisturizer, with flaking reported for a few days after use in some cases.
segments.combination: One combination-skin reviewer says it helps slough off dry patches that clog pores and leaves makeup application smoother.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report burning, stinging, redness, a chemical-burn feeling, or a new cystic pimple, while others with self-described sensitive skin say the tingling faded quickly and results were good when time and frequency were reduced.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (in their 50s to 70s) generally report smoother, softer, brighter skin and improved texture over weeks to months, with one noting it helped hydration and none reporting burns as severe as younger reviewers.
segments.normal: A reviewer without sensitive skin still found it stung and produced redness, but described the results afterward as worthwhile.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers report smoother texture, brighter tone, and a 'glow' with regular weekly or biweekly use; none report reduction in wrinkles specifically, and one 71-year-old notes it hasn't been miraculous for wrinkles despite improving texture.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers report dryness, tightness, or flaking in the days after use if not followed by a rich moisturizer; one describes escalating dryness and flaking over three days with no relief from moisturizing.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers say the product reduced overall redness and evened tone over time (including one with rosacea), but others report the product itself causing temporary or persistent redness immediately after use.
concerns.barrier: Some reviewers explicitly warn against use on a compromised skin barrier or broken skin, associating this with more severe burning; others report the product improved skin resilience and hydration with consistent use.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fading of dark spots, acne scars, sun spots, and hyperpigmentation with weeks to months of use, including on body scars; one reviewer's dark spots reappeared after stopping the product and faded again on resuming.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers describe reduced acne, closed comedones, and clearer pores with continued weekly use, including for hormonal and PCOS-related acne; however, a few report new breakouts, a cystic pimple, or a 'purging' period, and one reviewer explicitly says not to use it on active or inflamed acne.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report less visible shine and clearer pores with regular use, describing skin as 'even' rather than oily after weeks of use.

aspects.libelle: Dryness or flaking days after use

extraits.texte: I got this because I've been working on trying to have nicer skin. I patch tested on my hand it was fine. I put it on my face as directed washed it off and my face felt great... until the next day. I had a lite rash going from cheek to cheek. it was sensive to the touch but not painful, just uncomfortable. Day 2 the area became super dry. I moisturize twice a day and it isn't helping. I am on day 3 and the area is more dry and starting to flake. my face is way worse before I used the product. Really disappointed.

extraits.titre: Caused large cystic acne bump on chin--just say no!!
extraits.texte: I wanted to get a mild glycolic peel to keep my skin fresh. I saw this highly rated product from The Ordinary so I thought I'd give it a try. My skin felt sensitive for 1-2 days after using it and I thought my skin looked fresher. The problem is it caused a large cystic pimple on my chin that I now have no idea how to get rid of. How do I know it was the product? Because I don't get pimples any more due to age and this is the only product change that I made.

If you use this correctly, it is amazing! I have very oily skin and I get a lot of closed comedones and blackheads which is why I purchased this product - and it's very affordable. Using this only once a week, leaving it on for 5-7 minutes, then generously applying my moisturizer has made a huge difference in my skin! My face is finally baby smooth again and my pores are clearer almost immediately after using this resulting in plump, brighter skin. I wouldn't recommend using this on active or inflamed acne, and I definitely don't recommend using it as often as the bottle states…seriously, don't use it that often. A lot of irriation can come from potent products like this, but if you're careful using it and not overly sensitive, it really does work wonders!

extraits.titre: The only product I buy again and again
extraits.texte: I unfortunately have aging AND acne prone skin. I have been through ao many products, from good molecules to dermalogica to curology to drunk elephant. But nothing has visibly changed my skin the wat this product does. I used to deal with bad flaking combined with oily spots, but my skin is so even now. No flakes. No super shiny spots. Just allover dewy and even. I use it twice a week, after i cleanse my face in the shower so my pores are more open. I leave it for 15 minutes instead of 10, and wipe it off with a textured cotton pad for extra exfoliation. I don't have super sensitive skin so this works well for me, and ive used it for 4 years now so i know how much my skin can stand. Obviously tread lightly if you are new to the product! Start with 5 minutes if it burns too much and work your way up. And yes. It's supposed to burn! It's not comfortable. So many reviews complaining about this, but thats how a chemical peel works. If you don't feel it, its not removing your dead skin. Make sure you moisturize IMMEDIATELY after! Your skin will be very tight and clean. You'll feel so glowy! I'm not exaggerating when i say this product changed my life. My acne and confidence were so bad before. Using this consistently made all the difference. The photo shows my skin before, then 8 months later (i had been using the this product for 5 months at that point. Discoloration is still there but slowly fading!)
Got my 2nd bottle. I use once a week. Great for dry skin and acne prone sensitive skin. Brightens my complexion and helps fade dark spots.
I've been ordering and using it for a while now my dermatologist is OK with it and it worked for my rosacea

extraits.titre: Yes, I would buy this product again
extraits.texte: This product works really well for my skin. It calms down my rosacea and tightens my pores. I really like it. I use it about three times a week. It's convenient. It's not messy. Actually makes my skin feel more taught and it's easy on my purse. I highly recommend you give it a try.
